items.title: Landscape Parkour
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Do you want to see a beautiful and stunning scenery while doing parkour?
Then this is the map for you!
Four unique stages await you!

- Adventure mode and permanent daytime recommended
- 12 emeralds hidden around the map
- A time tracker/checkpoint system

Built by: Twilight

items.title: Mindcraft
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Challenge your minds with Mindcraft! Are you the master of Minecraft knowledge? Put yourself and your friends to the test to find the greatest gamer among you.

Featuring:
+ 90 Minecraft-themed questions to solve!
+ Cool Minecraft-themed dioramas!
+ Includes 5 skins designed inspired by Minecraft mobs!

items.title: Flash Mobs
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Neon rainbow colored mobs are brightening up the streets with their electric moves and funky beats. 15 skins in all. Grab a pack and steal the show!

items.title: Coolest Teens
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to show off how cool you are with these stylish outfits! Hopefully your friends don't get too jealous...

+ 12 teen skins
+ Awesome outfits

items.title: Rapper Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Do you think that you can rap, but are underestimated? Now it's your time to bring your talent on stage and become a superstar. With these 12 unique rapper skins you can make the choice of your minecraft character's life and become the richest and most popular player on your server!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Assassin Mobs
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
These monsters are secret assassins! Cool and mysterious skins will help you on your missions against the evil villagers!

- 12 Mob skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Soccer Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Do you have what it takes to be the world’s next soccer superstar? Train hard and you too can play for the best and most famous clubs! Kick-off your career with these athletic skins!

- 11 Teen skins
- By Geniely

items.title: Ancient Temple
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Welcome to a journey through history!

- Large, imposing temple complex
- Perfect start for your survival adventure
- By Team Etyhria

items.title: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker Skyblock
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Which island could you survive on? Are you a noob or a pro? Or maybe a hacker after all?

- 3 different skyblock islands
- By RareLoot

items.title: SCP Bunker
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
A super secret desolate and ruined laboratory complex is waiting to be explored! Wander through the empty hallways and tour the facilities' many rooms and labs!
Do you dare to go even further and explore what lies deep down beneath? 

- Testing facility survival spawn
- Underground bunker
- Licensed under CC-BY-SA
- By RareLoot

items.title: Prime Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Experience the heyday of teen life! Get the most out of your teenage years with these cool, fun, cute and modern skins! Get yourself some awesome new fashion styles!

- 12 Teen skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Stylish Anime Demons
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Become the most stylish anime demon in existence! Show all of your ghoul friends that you're the No. 1! Cool and fancy skins of your favourite anime-inspired ghouls are waiting for you!

- 12 Demon skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Dragon Teens II
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Even more cute dragon onesies are coming your way! Choose from a wide variety of new and cool as well as stylish skins! Add even more fantasy to your collection with this skin-pack!

- 12 Epic teen skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Castle of Hohenfels
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Have you always wanted to be ruler of your own kingdom? Rule your lands and care for your citizens. Great adventures await you at Hohenfels Castle.

- Castle survival spawn
- Large village nearby
- By Rareloot

items.title: Fantasy Treehouse Base
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Travel to the enchanted fantasy world and start your adventure now! This survival spawn is the perfect starter base for you. Explore the giant tree and its base, find secret chests and live in the treehouses. Start your journey from this beautiful spawn.

- Includes a giant treehouse village
- Secret chests and treasures
- Nicely decorated interior
- By Eternal Creations

items.title: Monkeys Paradise
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
They are not only good climbers, they are also really cute! The monkeys who live here are very trusting and are already very excited to meet you.

- Large area with amazing ruins to explore
- The monkeys can be fed
- A perfect and cute way to start your survival adventure
- By Team Ethyria

items.title: Plane Crash
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
You're on a plane on your way to vacation. Suddenly there are problems and the plane has to make an emergency landing on a small island. Now, survive on that small island and decide: Rather build a new civilization with big farms, or trying to escape from this untouched part of the earth? It is your choice! 

- Crashed plane
- Unique Lucky cow
- By RareLoot

items.title: Five Nights at Doll
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Haunted hallways, restless dolls and one objective: survive the night! As a security guard you must survive the many different monsters lurking in the hallways in a Minecraft spin on the popular survival horror genre!

- 4 different monsters with unique behaviour
- Resource management
- Pizza restaurant location
- By RareLoot

items.title: Rainbow Teens
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
As everybody knows: After bad weather a rainbow arises and the people can see the sunny side of life again. With the "Rainbow Teens" skinpack you can give everybody on your server an experience such as seing a rainbow in real life! These epic skins will put a smile on your friends faces!

- 12 skins
- By Rareloot

items.title: Invisible PVP Ninjas
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Sneak up on your opponents and surprise them with your ability to become a part of the scenery! Invisible ninjas are PVP pros, world's best hide and seek players and looking cool too. 

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Monsters Black & White
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Ever wanted to become a monster? Or a member of the undead?
Get ready to jump back in time, traveling back to the 40s, 50s, and 60s!

+ Perfect for horror!
+ 8 black and white stylised skins
+ 1 FREE skin: The Stalker

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Hype Beasts
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Today's trend is right around the corner! Dive into this new experience and try your favorite skin from these fantastic figures. Indeed, you'll find your style full of hype and become one with the game! The beasts are here and are ready to rule over the world. Join them!

+ 1 free skin
+ 11 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Pink Trends Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Love the color pink? Then this adorable collection is for you! Explore a variety of pink colored fashion from nekos, demons, bunnies, and more to wear.

+ 14 skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Obsidian Challenge
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Take on a challenge where every block you touch turns to obsidian. You can now only interact with blocks safely from a distance. Can you make it to the Ender dragon and beat the game? When you are finished with the challenge, reset the template and make the beautiful castle spawn build your new home.
-2300+ commands
